claims.location: source name, comment[data file], fraction identifier
claims.value: 90 RAW files arranged as C/RKO/HKO, five replicate pools each, six fractions F1-F6 each
claims.evidence: All 90 names uniquely match genotype code, two-digit replicate and F1-F6; the paper's mouse SUMOylome method describes five biological replicate pools and six fractions.

claims.value: C = wild type; RKO = Rnf212b knockout; HKO = Hei10 knockout
claims.evidence: Paper SUMOylome Analysis from Mouse Samples section maps genotype codes to the three mouse groups; PRIDE raw names carry those codes.

claims.location: characteristics[pooled sample], organism, organism part, sex
claims.evidence: Paper describes pools of 8 WT, 8 RKO, and 5 HKO testes per replicate; PRIDE sample protocol identifies testes from mice.
Control age of 17-19 days postpartum is given, but age/stage of knockout pools is not established for each run.

claims.location: instrument, acquisition, dissociation, collision energy, MS1 scan range
claims.value: Orbitrap Exploris 480 DDA, HCD, 25 NCE, 500-1500 m/z
claims.evidence: Accession-specific PRIDE sample protocol specifies these settings; structured experimentTypes also gives PRIDE:0000627.

claims.value: Lys-C then Asp-N; TCEP and chloroacetamide
claims.evidence: Accession-specific PRIDE protocol names Lys-C before anti-SUMO2/3 IP, then Asp-N for second-stage digestion; TCEP and CAA are named during sample preparation.

Accession-specific PRIDE sample protocol states endogenous SUMO2/3-modified peptides were immunoprecipitated using approximately 7 microlitres of 8A2 anti-SUMO2/3 antibody coupled to Protein G agarose per sample.

claims.value: variable protein N-terminal acetylation, M oxidation, peptide N-terminal pyroglutamate, and Lys SUMOylation using DVFQQQTGG (960.4301 Da)
claims.evidence: PRIDE data processing protocol lists all four variable modifications and gives the exact custom SUMO composition and monoisotopic mass. No unrelated Unimod remnant accession was assigned.

claims.location: comment[precursor mass tolerance], comment[fragment mass tolerance]
claims.evidence: Accession-specific sample and data processing protocols provide no search mass tolerance. The 15 ppm dynamic-exclusion setting is not a search tolerance.

limitations: Pooled animals' individual identifiers and knockout ages are not available in the accessible record.
Custom SUMOylation is encoded using its measured monoisotopic mass, without an Unimod accession; UNIMOD:932 describes a different VFQQQTGG remnant.
The optional enrichment-process ontology field is omitted because an exact permitted PRIDE/EFO descendant term was not verified; the evidence-backed 8A2 anti-SUMO2/3 antibody is retained.
The reconcile helper checks only the first of two repeated cleavage-agent columns and therefore incorrectly flags Asp-N as absent. Both Lys-C and Asp-N are present in every row.
